q: What must a relationship manager never promise a PMS client?
reference: Never promise guaranteed or minimum returns, or that the strategy will beat the benchmark; never project past returns forward.

A.answer: A relationship manager must never promise or imply **guaranteed returns, a minimum return, or that the strategy will beat the benchmark**; must never **project past returns into the future** (e.g., “you will double your money in 4 years”); must never **offer a fee discount, cashback, gift or rebate** to win a client; and must never **promise that discretionary clients will get the same returns as the published model** [1][2].

cited.text:
## 7. What an RM must never do or promise

- Never promise or imply guaranteed returns, a minimum return, or that the strategy will beat the benchmark. Say "there is no assurance that the objectives will be achieved".
